verdict.rationale: The evidence describes AvaTax's on-request tax-calculation APIs, SDKs, an MCP server, and a mention of an 'Avi Agent'. None of it documents a user-configurable automation, recurring schedule, or background agent that runs autonomously. Phrases like 'automates excise tax determination' describe sibling products' core functions, which is adjacent material and not a way to set up background automations, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
